'''San Andreas Theme Song''' is a song by [[Young Maylay]] (the voice actor for [[Carl Johnson]]) where he raps to the [[Theme from San Andreas|theme]] from ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. The song is from the album ''{{WP|San Andreas: The Original Mixtape}}''.

The rap was not produced for the game itself—it was released one year after, in 2005.
